name: Alwajh almustaear
overview: The work tells the story of "Shams", who was raised in the corps of a second family, after the people of her village abandoned her, and demanded that she be removed as a result of a rare disease that leads to her hair loss, and soon "Shams" grew up in the middle of the new family that she called "Maryam", and inherited her money and became a wealthy businesswoman. The years pass and the tragedy of Shams with her niece is repeated.
